question: Should OpenClaw accept this focused native Anthropic replay-policy change: preserve fable5 and active tool-use thinking, but drop completed-turn thinking for non-fable5 thinking-enabled requests?
rationale: The patch is narrow and live-proofed, but it intentionally changes provider replay semantics for existing signed-thinking histories and overlaps an active replay cluster.

options.title: Accept focused native policy

options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers choose a broader sanitizer or recovery branch as the canonical landing path and that replacement becomes proof-positive and mergeable.
